title: OpenAI introduces a limited Luna fallback after regular usage runs out
friendlyTitle: Some ChatGPT users get extra Luna use after hitting a limit
summary: OpenAI says selected personal Plus and Pro accounts can continue some Codex or ChatGPT Work conversations with GPT-5.6 Luna after exhausting regular usage. Luna Reserve has a separate finite allowance, does not add API credits and is not available to every account or to Business and Enterprise workspaces.
friendlySummary: Selected Plus and Pro users may keep working with the Luna model after normal usage is used up. The extra allowance is limited and is not available to everyone.
whyItMatters: The fallback may keep individual workflows moving when premium limits are reached, but it is not guaranteed capacity. Users should treat it as a temporary continuity feature rather than plan critical work around it.
friendlyWhyItMatters: It may help you finish a task after reaching your normal limit, but you should not depend on it for important work.
